name: helper-pay
description: An assistant for paying the people who help at home: agreements from messy texts and screenshots, bills checked against them, explicit approval.

scripts.test: go test -C backend ./... && npm -w infra test
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ui "go run -C backend ./cmd/local" "npm -w ui run dev"
scripts.deploy: npm -w ui run build && npm -w infra run deploy
